node.statement: Radius and domain: (1.1) defines bar-C_E=max{1,C_E}, C_V=bar-C_E*C_A and rho_T as a minimum containing rho_AI and epsilon_E/C_A. Thus 0<=eta<=rho_T implies eta<=rho_AI and, by lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization, epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta<=epsilon_E. In the ambient finite-dimensional setup A=Im(tilde-Phi) is finite-dimensional.
